name: Inana's Descent to the Netherworld
aliases: Inana's descent to the nether world
candidate_type: underworld narrative / deity tradition / cuneiform literary text

discovery.summary: The Electronic Text Corpus of Sumerian Literature preserves a scholarly translation of a Sumerian composition in which Inana leaves the upper world and descends to the netherworld, passing through gates where regalia are removed. ORACC independently documents Inana/Ištar in Mesopotamian tradition, and CDLI provides an Old Babylonian physical tablet witness (P275004) to the composition.
discovery.why_relevant: Strong provenance-first record with scholarly composite text, primary manuscript witness, explicit manuscript variation, reusable entities, atomic claims, and evidence edges.

notes: Merged into canonical record MYTH-MES-INANA-DESCENT-000001 on 2026-09-07T18:26:10Z. Candidate retained as discovery provenance. The canonical record preserves the distinction between Sumerian Inana and related Akkadian Ištar descent traditions. No theological assessment has been made.
